frontmatter.summary: R14.3 in place: S2 FBS↔Design State mapping ported from R14.4 (§ 3.3), then C45 resolved in §§ 2.2/6.1 — but on a corrected model. R14.4's S3 derivation rule was rejected as unsound: a Design State trail is partitioned, not linear, and reformulation redefines a state space rather than linking two states. § 6.1 now states the precondition (design-space membership) instead of a derivation. Design-space formalisation left to T4 per the series coherence map.
